text:
Noah Rivera: FYI rolling a deprecation for legacy request header X-Redwood-User -> new header X-Rw-User. Server will accept both for 60 days with a warning log, then reject X-Redwood-User.
Priya Kapoor: Why the change? Is it just length/consistency?
Noah Rivera: Mostly consistency with shorter prefix and to avoid collisions with partner headers. Also aligns with our telemetry namespace.
Ben Lowe: Any impact to Dedicated/Private customers?
Noah Rivera: No forced change server-side unless they upgrade. If they use SDKs that set headers automatically, SDK update will map header names for them during the 60-day window.
Maya Fernandez: Docs action items? I can draft migration page + code diffs.
Priya Kapoor: Please include curl + node + python examples showing old vs new header. Also a small script to patch CI that checks for old header usage.
Maya Fernandez: On it. Example snippet I'll add: ```bash
# old
curl -H "X-Redwood-User: team-a" https://api.redwood.example/generate
# new
curl -H "X-Rw-User: team-a" https://api.redwood.example/generate
```
Ben Lowe: Rollout plan? Canary first? Need to know rollback criteria.
Noah Rivera: Yes: canary (4%) 24h -> 25% 48h -> 100%. Rollback if error spike >1% above baseline or p95 increase >20%. Canary dashboard: https://observability.redwood/canary/headers-deprecation
Priya Kapoor: Add a note to the SDK CHANGELOG that headers are being renamed and that SDKs will auto-map for 60 days. People scanning changelogs must see it.
Maya Fernandez: I'll create a changelog snippet and add a migration checklist for Solutions. Also adding a `header-deprecation` tag to docs-preview issues.
DocsBot: Preview docs live: https://docs.redwood/preview/header-deprecation. Label any issues `header-deprecation` and tag @Maya Fernandez.
Ben Lowe: Can we include a small compat shim env var for customers who can't change headers quickly? E.g., RW_COMPAT_HEADER_MAP=1 for one minor?
Noah Rivera: We can include a server-side shim for one minor release but prefer customers to migrate quickly. We'll document the shim as emergency-only.
Priya Kapoor: Legal/Customer comms: need explicit 60-day date ranges and suggested migration timeline for enterprise contracts.
Maya Fernandez: I'll draft the customer-facing blurb and ping Legal.
Noah Rivera: Thanks — will post the public announcement after 100% rollout. If anyone sees unexpected traffic patterns on the canary link above, report here or tag @Noah Rivera.
Priya Kapoor: :thumbsup:
Ben Lowe: :eyes: I'll monitor infra.
DocsBot: Reminder: open preview issues with label `header-deprecation` and tag @Maya Fernandez for review.
Noah Rivera: Closing loop: deprecation notice posted internally; will update this thread at 25% and 100% checkpoints.
